newsitem.title: USA: Medical says to spin off Essential Care.
newsitem.headline: Medical says to spin off Essential Care.

text.p: Medical Industries of America Inc said Monday that it intends to spin off its wholly owned subsidiaries, Essential Care Clinic No. 1 Inc and Essential Care Clinic No. 5 Inc, into a separate company that will become publicly traded upon registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

As a result of the spin-off, Medical Industries said it intends to issue a stock dividend in this new company to each registered shareholder of Medical Industries. Simultaneously, Diversified Medical Holdings Inc has agreed in principle to merge into this new entity, Medical Industries said.
